meaning: Correlation between the monsoon ENSO index and district monsoon departure, 1950-2024
source: IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily rainfall (Pai et al. 2014); NOAA CPC RONI / ONI ERSST.v6
vulnerability_direction: more negative = El Nino years more strongly associated with lower monsoon rainfall; treated as greater exposure
evidence_in_this_project: measured here: historical rainfall/ENSO statistics 1950-2024 (association, not causation)
redundant_with: enso_rain_spearman_rho (same two underlying series (not an algebraic identity)); enso_rain_slope_pct_per_degC (same two underlying series (not an algebraic identity))
reason: Same two series as the slope (r = 0.92) but unitless; the slope also carries the size of the rainfall response.

meaning: Rank correlation between the same two series
source: IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily rainfall (Pai et al. 2014); NOAA CPC RONI / ONI ERSST.v6
vulnerability_direction: more negative = stronger association; treated as greater exposure
evidence_in_this_project: measured here: historical rainfall/ENSO statistics 1950-2024 (association, not causation)
redundant_with: enso_rain_pearson_r (same two underlying series (not an algebraic identity))
reason: Robustness version of the Pearson correlation, not separate information (r = 0.92 with Pearson, 0.95 with slope).

meaning: Average change in monsoon departure (%) per 1 degC of the monsoon ENSO index, 1950-2024
source: IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily rainfall (Pai et al. 2014); NOAA CPC RONI / ONI ERSST.v6
formula: OLS slope of D_y on I_y over T
vulnerability_direction: more negative = larger average rainfall decrease associated with El Nino warming; treated as greater exposure
evidence_in_this_project: measured here: historical rainfall/ENSO statistics 1950-2024 (association, not causation)
redundant_with: enso_rain_pearson_r (same two underlying series (not an algebraic identity))
reason: Uses all 75 years (1950-2024) and is the most stable climate variable (r = 0.98 between RONI and ONI versions); easy unit. Describes a historical association, not a demonstrated cause.

meaning: Coefficient of variation of June-September rainfall
source: IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily rainfall (Pai et al. 2014)
vulnerability_direction: higher = more variable monsoon; treated as greater exposure
evidence_in_this_project: measured here: historical rainfall/ENSO statistics 1950-2024 (association, not causation)
reason: General rainfall variability, not specific to El Nino; strongly skewed by the suspect Pune/Jalna IMD values (skew 3.0).

meaning: Mean monsoon deficit in El Nino years
source: IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily rainfall (Pai et al. 2014); NOAA CPC RONI / ONI ERSST.v6
vulnerability_direction: higher = larger average deficit in El Nino years; treated as greater exposure
evidence_in_this_project: measured here: historical rainfall/ENSO statistics 1950-2024 (association, not causation)
redundant_with: rain_en_minus_nonen_deficit_pct (identity: minus-version = El Nino mean deficit - non-El-Nino mean deficit)
reason: Direct and easy to explain, but unstable: r = 0.59 between RONI and ONI versions; Pune is an outlier (z = 2.6) partly because of suspect IMD values.

meaning: Largest monsoon deficit in any El Nino year
source: IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily rainfall (Pai et al. 2014); NOAA CPC RONI / ONI ERSST.v6
vulnerability_direction: higher = worse worst-case El Nino monsoon; treated as greater exposure
evidence_in_this_project: measured here: historical rainfall/ENSO statistics 1950-2024 (association, not causation)
reason: Worst-case magnitude, stable across indices (r = 0.98); depends on a single year per district, so sensitive to single-year data errors.

meaning: Share of El Nino years with a deficient monsoon (IMD: departure <= -20%)
source: IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily rainfall (Pai et al. 2014); NOAA CPC RONI / ONI ERSST.v6
vulnerability_direction: higher = El Nino years more often deficient; treated as greater exposure
evidence_in_this_project: measured here: historical rainfall/ENSO statistics 1950-2024 (association, not causation)
redundant_with: rain_en_minus_nonen_deficient_frequency (identity: minus-version = El Nino frequency - non-El-Nino frequency)
reason: Measures how often El Nino years were deficient in this district, using IMD's own category; reasonably stable (r = 0.87 RONI vs ONI). Concern: Pune z = 3.6, partly from suspect IMD years.

meaning: Mean monsoon SPI in El Nino years
source: IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily rainfall (Pai et al. 2014); NOAA CPC RONI / ONI ERSST.v6
formula: mean over E of SPI_y (gamma fit on baseline years)
vulnerability_direction: more negative = drier El Nino years; treated as greater exposure
evidence_in_this_project: measured here: historical rainfall/ENSO statistics 1950-2024 (association, not causation)
reason: Another scale for the mean El Nino deficit (r = -0.90); least stable across indices (r = 0.42); harder to explain.

meaning: El Nino mean deficit minus non-El-Nino mean deficit
source: IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily rainfall (Pai et al. 2014); NOAA CPC RONI / ONI ERSST.v6
vulnerability_direction: higher = El Nino years drier than other years; treated as greater exposure
evidence_in_this_project: measured here: historical rainfall/ENSO statistics 1950-2024 (association, not causation)
redundant_with: rain_en_mean_deficit_pct (identity: minus-version = El Nino mean deficit - non-El-Nino mean deficit)
reason: Exactly determined by the mean deficit and the non-El-Nino deficit; unstable across indices (r = 0.48); overlaps with the slope (r = -0.87).

meaning: El Nino deficient frequency minus non-El-Nino deficient frequency
source: IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily rainfall (Pai et al. 2014); NOAA CPC RONI / ONI ERSST.v6
vulnerability_direction: higher = deficient monsoons more frequent in El Nino years; treated as greater exposure
evidence_in_this_project: measured here: historical rainfall/ENSO statistics 1950-2024 (association, not causation)
redundant_with: rain_en_deficient_frequency (identity: minus-version = El Nino frequency - non-El-Nino frequency)
reason: Exactly determined by the two frequencies (r = 0.91 with El Nino frequency); less stable (r = 0.71 across indices).
